dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Aibek! Thank goodness I found you. I have never been to an airport before. Where is the check-in desk for my flight?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Don't worry, Kamila! The check-in desks are on the ground floor, directly opposite the main entrance. You can see them from here.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: And what do I do after check-in?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: After check-in, you go through security. The security checkpoint is at the end of the hall, just behind the café on the left.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Is the café before or after security?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Before security. You can get a coffee there while you wait — it is next to the information desk, on the right side of the hall.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: And the departure gate — where do I find that?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: After security, go upstairs to the second floor. All the departure gates are there. Your gate number is on the departures board — it is on the wall above the security entrance.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: And my suitcase — should I check it in?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Yes. The baggage drop is at your check-in desk. When you land in Karagandy, the baggage claim is on the ground floor, next to the arrivals exit.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: One more question — is there a shop here? I want to buy something for my mother.

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Yes! There are two shops. One is between the café and the information desk — it sells snacks and newspapers. The bigger one is upstairs, in front of Gate 3.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Perfect! Thank you so much, Aibek. You have saved me today!

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: No problem — but go to the check-in desk now. Your flight is in ninety minutes!

task1Items.question: Kamila has been to this airport several times before.
The check-in desks are on the ground floor, opposite the main entrance.
The café is located after the security checkpoint.
The departure gates are all on the second floor.
The shop between the café and information desk sells electronics.
Kamila's flight departs in ninety minutes.
